questions.question: If your motorcycle starts to handle differently while riding, what should you do?

options.text: Pull over and check the tires.
Pull over to check the chain.
Pull over to check the windshield.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over and check the tires.
questions.explanation: A sudden change in how your motorcycle handles may mean a tire has failed. If you feel your motorcycle handling differently, pull over safely and check your tires.

questions.question: If you think your motorcycle will take longer to stop than usual, what should you do?

options.text: Increase the distance between you and the vehicle ahead.
Decrease the distance between you and the vehicle ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase the distance between you and the vehicle ahead.
questions.explanation: Increase your following distance when riding on a slippery surface. If your motorcycle needs more time to stop, give yourself more space between you and the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants provide the best protection when riding a motorcycle.

questions.question: How does riding with a passenger affect a motorcycle?

options.text: It usually does not change how the motorcycle handles.
It is usually safe for new riders.
It can change how the motorcycle handles.
It is encouraged to help riders get used to different situations.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can change how the motorcycle handles.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds extra weight to your motorcycle, which changes how it handles. Only experienced riders should carry passengers.

questions.question: Which type of clothing helps other drivers see you?
questions.explanation: Wear gear that makes you and your motorcycle easier to spot. Bright, reflective clothing helps other drivers see you.

questions.question: What happens when you drink alcohol quickly?

options.text: Alcohol builds up in your body.
Alcohol has less effect on you.
You are less likely to be stopped by police.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alcohol builds up in your body.
questions.explanation: When you drink quickly, alcohol builds up in your body. It is never safe to ride a motorcycle after drinking any amount of alcohol.

questions.question: How can you make night riding safer?

options.text: Night riding is not safe because other drivers cannot see your turn signals.
Only ride at night in the city.

questions.explanation: Wear reflective materials when riding at night to make yourself more visible to other drivers.

questions.question: What should you do if you drink alcohol?

options.text: Decide if you can ride based on how you feel after drinking.
Set a limit beforehand so you can still ride safely.
Do not worry about riding if you feel fine.

questions.explanation: The safest way to avoid the risks of riding after drinking is to not ride at all. Any amount of alcohol can affect your riding ability.

questions.question: What happens after drinking just one alcoholic drink?

options.text: Your judgment and riding ability can still be affected.
There is usually no effect on your body.
There is an effect, but it only lasts a short time.
There is an effect, but drinking coffee can eliminate it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your judgment and riding ability can still be affected.
questions.explanation: Even one drink can affect your judgment and riding skills. Your body needs time to remove alcohol. Coffee cannot speed up this process.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT required on a DOT-compliant helmet?

options.text: Bright colors painted on the outside.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bright colors painted on the outside.
questions.explanation: A DOT-compliant helmet must have an impact-resistant outer shell, an impact-absorbing inner liner, a comfort liner, and a chinstrap retention system. Bright paint colors are not required.

questions.question: Where should you find information about your specific motorcycle?

options.text: Someone who rides a different type of motorcycle.
A television show about motorcycle riding.

questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual before riding your motorcycle for the first time. This is especially important if you are riding a borrowed motorcycle.

questions.question: How should you check tire pressure?

options.text: Look at the tire and guess.
Squeeze the tire with your hand.

questions.explanation: Use a tire gauge before every ride. A tire that looks fine may actually be under-inflated, so looking at it is not enough.

questions.question: Which of these do you NOT need to check before riding your motorcycle?

options.text: Both brake controls work and the brake light turns on.

questions.explanation: Before riding, check tire pressure and condition, oil and fluid levels, and make sure the headlight, high beam, taillight, signal lights, and brake light all work.

questions.question: What should you NOT check on your tires before a ride?
questions.explanation: Before each ride, check the air pressure, tread, and general wear of your tires.

questions.question: What kind of shoes should you wear when riding?

options.text: Shoes with long laces that hang out.

questions.explanation: Wear boots or shoes that are tall and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles. Heels should be short so they don't catch on things. Laces should be tucked in so they don't catch on the motorcycle.

questions.question: Most motorcycle crashes happen during daylight. What should you do?

options.text: Ride on the shoulder away from traffic.

questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during daylight. Always wear bright clothing when riding so other people can see you better, even during the day.

questions.question: Which sign is yellow with black lettering or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: When should you use your turn signal?

options.text: When you plan to speed up.
Only when there is heavy traffic.

questions.explanation: Use your turn signal every time you turn or change lanes, even if you think no one else is around.

questions.question: When you brake, which brakes should you use?

options.text: Both brakes at the same time.
Either brake, but never both together.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: Always use both brakes at the same time to stop. The brakes work best when used together.

questions.question: How can you be more visible to other drivers?

options.text: Add extra lights to your motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Add extra lights to your motorcycle.
questions.explanation: To be more visible, wear bright or reflective clothing. You can also add extra lights to your motorcycle, use your turn signals, and flash your brake light when needed.

questions.question: A rectangular sign may be a:
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs are rectangular with white background and black lettering. These signs show road rules. You must follow the rules on these signs.

questions.question: If you wait an hour per alcoholic drink before you ride your motorcycle:

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Your skills will not be affected.
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly.

questions.explanation: Your body removes about one drink per hour. However, alcohol can still build up in your system. This buildup can still affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: Impairment from alcohol:

options.text: Begins at about half of the legal limit.
Occurs only if you have had multiple drinks.

questions.explanation: Even one drink can affect your ability to ride safely. You can be impaired well below the legal limit. No amount of alcohol is safe before riding.

questions.question: Which of the following is not important when looking for a motorcycle helmet?

options.text: The helmet meets U.S. Department of Transportation standards.
The helmet fits snugly all the way around your head.
The helmet has no obvious defects, such as cracks or loose padding.

questions.explanation: For the best protection, check that your helmet meets U.S. DOT standards, fits snugly around your head, and has no cracks, loose padding, or frayed straps. Appearance does not affect safety.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Not wear a jacket if it's warm out.
Always wear a jacket, even if it's warm out.
Not be concerned about long shoelaces.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always wear a jacket, even if it's warm out.
questions.explanation: Always wear a long-sleeved jacket when riding, even in warm weather. A jacket protects you and helps prevent dehydration. Also wear long pants and tuck in your shoelaces so they do not get caught.
